label: Dataset v1.2
signing: none (Sign to Run Locally; no development team)
note: Four reference apps, 624 (messages) and 648 (calendar) cases. The renamed people's cases and Spotlight probes were measured with the v1.2 seeds; every other observation comes from the identical v1.1 cases measured on the same day (per-app record: results/phase4/<app>/MERGE.json). Earlier dataset versions and their raw results are kept in the development repository because they contain names replaced before publication; v1.2 differs from v1.1 only by those renames and its scores are identical.
